items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: He had one fella from here named Henderson, a piano player named Henderson. Andrew Henderson.

ctx.x: Snookum Russell had a fine band. But his New Orleans musicians?
Who? His band? No. He had one fella from here named Henderson, a piano player named Henderson. Andrew Henderson.
Yeah, I didn't know him. He is. So Snookum was playing bass in that band? Who? So Snookum was playing bass in that band?
